# Repository Instructions for Coding Agents

Read README.md and the relevant files under docs before editing. This product handles employment, voice, identity, behavioural evidence, and potentially financial workflows. Preserve consent, explainability, tenant isolation, auditability, accessibility, and low-bandwidth mobile behaviour.

Never:
- score accent, emotion, caste, religion, gender, disability, health, or socioeconomic status;
- make AI the sole rejection mechanism;
- invent external API access;
- store secrets in code;
- conflate technical failures with candidate reliability;
- publish employer SOP content without approval;
- claim a feature is verified without evidence.

Every change should include tests and documentation updates.
